bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to arts and cultural heritage; appropriating money for the Urban Debate League.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATIONS; URBAN DEBATE LEAGUE.

$250,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $250,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the Board of Directors of the Minnesota Humanities Center for a grant to the Minnesota Urban Debate League to offer improved professional development programming and expand services to youth in more geographic areas.
additions: $250,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $250,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the Board of Directors of the Minnesota Humanities Center for a grant to the Minnesota Urban Debate League to offer improved professional development programming and expand services to youth in more geographic areas.
